messages:
Priya (sales): FYI FinNova asked if we can pin orca-mini-1.3b for them in ap-southeast-1 and guarantee v1.3. They want a dedicated route for low-latency inference.
Alex (product): thanks — do we have their contract / commitment level? reserved capacity?
Priya (sales): small POC to start. They said 'will convert to paid if latency < 120ms p95 and costs < $0.004/token'. No reserved commit yet.
Alex (product): ok. Need to triage: model legal/licensing, infra availability in APAC, quantization/accuracy tradeoffs, and launch criteria. I'll draft acceptance checklist.
Nora (ml): orca-mini-1.3b is permissively licensed (APLC-like) but needs eval on our regression suite. Quantized 8-bit recipes exist; 4-bit still flaky on some kernels.
Luis (infra): APAC pool has T4s and some A10Gs. L4s not widely available in that region. 1.3b should run fine on A10G or T4 with fp16/8bit. 4-bit int8 kernels require newer cuBlas/TF versions — we may need runtime bump.
Sam (support): can we provide a temporary fallback to hosted region eu-west if APAC capacity spikes? FinNova wants geo-pin though.
Alex (product): fallback acceptable as long as customer consents. For product backlog we need to capture pin + SLA negotiation + quantization profile + rollouts. Prioritize: 1) legal signoff 2) perf benchmarks in APAC 3) define SLO and cost estimate 4) rollout plan.
Priya (sales): customer prefers pin over fallback; they often have regulatory latency needs in APAC. But they can accept staged rollout if we promise pinned route within 3 weeks.
Nora (ml): for benching I'll need a sample prompt set from them (finance domain) and their target sequence length. Also need to lock model commit hash (v1.3) — do they mean specific weights?
Priya (sales): they said 'v1.3' explicitly — I'll ask for the exact checkpoint.
Luis (infra): rough infra ETA: if we avoid 4-bit and use fp16/8bit on A10G, we can spin a pinned route within 5 business days once model artifact is validated. If we require 4-bit L4 optimizations, add 2-3 weeks for runtime/kernel work.
Alex (product): acceptance criteria I'm proposing (draft):
- Model artifact confirmed (commit/checksum) and license cleared by legal.
- Perf: p50 < 60ms, p95 < 120ms on pinned APAC configuration for customer's prompt set.
- Quality regression: rouge/accuracy delta within threshold of baseline (no >2% degradation).
- Cost estimate agreed and documented.
- Rollout plan with canary and automatic fallback defined.
Nora (ml): + add eval suite runnable in CI and a sample quantization config we approve.
Sam (support): add on-call rotation note and escalation path in runbook.
Priya (sales): I'll get the prompt set and checkpoint today. Also pushing them to sign 3-month reserved for predictable capacity.
Alex (product): ok — owners: legal = Sam, infra = Luis, ml eval = Nora, product PM = Alex, sales lead = Priya. I'll put this in the backlog with priority P1-customer-onboard.
OnboardingBot: model-package-check: artifact uploaded to s3://onboard-packages/fin-nova/orca-mini-1.3b/sha256:abcd1234
Nora (ml): received package. I'll run regression locally and post results here.
Luis (infra): created temp pinned route in ap-southeast-1 on A10G (staging) — endpoint: /v1/models/fin-nova-orca-mini-1.3b-staging. Load-testing tomorrow.
Alex (product): great. Priya, keep asking for reservation but don't block POC. We need to define SLA language for pinned routes (latency + availability + fallback).
Priya (sales): noted. I'll share the customer's expectations and get the checkpoint.
Nora (ml): first perf run shows p95 on their prompts ~140ms on staging fp16 — need to try 8bit quant and kernel config. Will update.
Alex (product): thanks. If 8bit gets us under 120ms without >2% quality loss, that's acceptable. If not, we escalate to infra for possible hardware change.
Luis (infra): if needed we can route to A100 in SEA partner region but that requires extra cost — flagging now.
Sam (support): once quality/perf locked, I'll draft runbook + rollback steps.
Priya (sales): customer open to minor quality delta if cost holds. I'll negotiate. :thumbsup:
Alex (product): timeline expectation: aim for staged customer demo in 7 business days, full pinned route within 3 weeks if legal & perf ok. I'll create a GH issue and link acceptance checklist.
Priya (sales): thanks — will update after checkpoint and reservation convo.
Nora (ml): ongoing — posting eval artifact in 24h.
Luis (infra): noted, will reserve capacity slots pending contract.
Sam (support): standing by for runbook details.
